provenance.source_title: Why Red Bull Isn't A Drink Company
provenance.source_title_zh: 为什么红牛不是一家饮料公司

examples.psychological_goal: 否定观众对奇观主办方的默认预设,用"凑近看"把好奇转成品牌揭晓
examples.expression_mechanism: 先立否定句推翻预设,再用近距离视角动作完成反主揭晓
examples.example_text: this spectacle was not from NASA or Space X… When you look a little closer, you see the unmistakable symbol of Red Bull.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"不是你想象的主体"式反转在 30 秒内重写观众预设
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制具体事件与品牌;新主题需要一个观众会默认归因于权威机构的代表事件

examples.psychological_goal: 用同口径年销量与国家数建立统治级尺度,证明主问题值得看下去
examples.expression_mechanism: 规模数字后紧跟人口类比压缩,把天文数字转成体感
examples.example_text: sold more than 9.8 billion cans across 172 countries — more than one can for every person on the planet!
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"数字+类比"的尺度炫示句式,为开头契约加码
examples.negative_instruction: 不要编造数字;新主题必须用可核查的同口径规模数据

examples.psychological_goal: 给出被主流忽视人群才是硬需求方的定位洞察,提供第一个可复述观点
examples.expression_mechanism: 用"actually"翻转目标人群预设,一句话完成市场重定位
examples.example_text: it was actually the blue collar working man who needed energy much more
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用人群翻转句式表达差异化定位洞察
examples.negative_instruction: 不要照搬人群标签;新主题要找到自己材料里被忽视的真实需求方

examples.psychological_goal: 用一场反差感相遇预告下一阶段,把本土故事接到全球故事
examples.expression_mechanism: 小人物身份与大帝国结果的反差预告,完成段落换挡
examples.example_text: it was an unlikely encounter with an Austrian businessman selling toothpaste, that would soon make this drink a multi-billion dollar global empire.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"不起眼的 X 将带来巨大 Y"的前向悬念换挡
examples.negative_instruction: 不要空喊"接下来更精彩";预告必须带具体反差元素

examples.psychological_goal: 用一行反差速写让人物立体可亲,为后来的大胆决策铺垫性格
examples.expression_mechanism: 三连玩乐动名词加冷面结果句,笑点依附于人物真实细节
examples.example_text: between partying, traveling, and chasing girls, It took him 10 years to graduate
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句话反差速写建立人物性格,不靠形容词
examples.negative_instruction: 不要为了搞笑而搞笑;速写必须与后文决策形成因果

examples.psychological_goal: 让观众代入"亲测有效"的尤里卡时刻,相信机会真实存在
examples.expression_mechanism: 亲身痛点+即时见效的递进(not only…no longer),把功效落到私人体验
examples.example_text: Dietrich tried it, and in just a few minutes he not only felt much more energized, he no longer had his jet lag.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用私人痛点被解决的时刻作为帝国故事的起点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要夸大功效;新素材的尤里卡时刻必须有真实出处

examples.psychological_goal: 用极差的上市前调研制造"该不该继续"的张力,衬托后续坚持
examples.expression_mechanism: 短判断句加引语证据,负面证据先行的张力营造
examples.example_text: the feedback was awful. Trial groups said the drink tasted ‘disgusting’.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在关键决策前先给反对证据,让坚持显得有代价
examples.negative_instruction: 不要编造负面反馈;反对证据必须来自真实调研或事实

examples.psychological_goal: 展示零预算也能制造好奇的心机战术,给观众"还能这样"的巧思快感
examples.expression_mechanism: 动名词开头的战术句+目的从句,把心机讲成机制
examples.example_text: leaving empty cans in bars and nightclubs, so that people would constantly see the logo and be curious to try the drink themselves.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把游击战术写成"动作+心理目的"的机制句
examples.negative_instruction: 不要只罗列动作;每个战术必须点明它撬动的心理机制

examples.psychological_goal: 坦白无秘方无专利的硬伤,为"销量反涨"悖论蓄势
examples.expression_mechanism: 先承认致命短板,再用事实佐证,坦白发人深省
examples.example_text: Red Bull has no secret, patented formula. All the ingredients are clearly labeled on the can.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用主动坦白硬伤来放大后续的反直觉结果
examples.negative_instruction: 不要掩饰短板;悖论的力量来自坦白而非掩饰

examples.psychological_goal: 用创始人口径完成"不是 A 是 B"的品类重定义,改变观众认知框架
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定句+重命名短句,两句独立成拍完成主体重构
examples.example_text: Red Bull never set out to be a beverage company. It was a story-telling company.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习"从来不是 X,而是 Y"的重命名双句结构
examples.negative_instruction: 不要滥用重定义;新主题必须确有主业与表面品类分离的证据

examples.psychological_goal: 用直播纪录与播放量兑现开场奇观,给观众首尾闭环的满足
examples.expression_mechanism: 纪录事实+量级数字的连续兑现,前段伏笔在此全额回收
examples.example_text: The YouTube video of this set a world record for most concurrent live streams, and has gone on to reach well over 120 million views.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开场悬念登记为后段的数据化回收点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要忘记回收;开场埋的奇观必须在中后段用结果兑现

examples.psychological_goal: 用反常识行为把观众推到主重定义门口,完成顶点预告
examples.expression_mechanism: 元评论预告+反常识行为揭示,两步把好奇推到峰值
examples.example_text: during all these events and spectacles the company puts on, they hardly ever refer to their drink.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在主答案前先给一个违反直觉的行为证据
examples.negative_instruction: 不要提前泄底;反常识证据要留着托起重定义句

examples.psychological_goal: 标题承诺在此全额兑现,给观众等待已久的顿悟时刻
examples.expression_mechanism: 引导短句(The truth is)+对仗重定义句,标题句式的正面回应
examples.example_text: The truth is Red Bull isn’t really a drinks company, it’s really a marketing company.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习主承诺兑现句要直接回应标题句式,不绕弯
examples.negative_instruction: 不要让兑现句偏离标题问法;答案必须与问题同构

examples.psychological_goal: 用起点与现状的倒置对照制造反讽快感,放大营销力量的落点
examples.expression_mechanism: 过去时与现在时的对仗倒置,一句话装下整个反讽
examples.example_text: Red Bull started out as the cheapest energy drink, now it’s one of the most expensive.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"起点 X、如今反 X"的倒置句压缩品牌弧线
examples.negative_instruction: 不要只给结论;倒置对照需要两个时间点的事实支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用成分风波维持争议段的递进张力与窥探欲
examples.expression_mechanism: 时间地点+惊人发现的名词化陈述,克制但抓人
examples.example_text: Then in Germany in 2009 red bull cola was found to contain trace amounts of cocaine
examples.usage_instruction: 学习争议案例用"何时何地+发现"的克制句式,不渲染
examples.negative_instruction: 不要渲染猎奇;成分与法律表述必须准确克制

examples.psychological_goal: 用常识吐槽给荒谬诉讼定调,让观众与叙述者站在同一边
examples.expression_mechanism: 字面化归谬(no one expected to grow wings)+判断句,公允限定后的个人观点
examples.example_text: surely nobody actually expected to grow literal wings and fly, so this lawsuit seemed like a frivolous cash grab.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习对荒谬案例先公允限定再常识吐槽的双层结构
examples.negative_instruction: 不要直接嘲讽;吐槽前先给对方的公平让步

examples.psychological_goal: 把争议升级到几乎无人知晓的家族丑闻,满足窥探欲并给形象打折
examples.expression_mechanism: "多数人不知道"的知情人姿态+身份揭示+指控陈述
examples.example_text: the heir to red bull’s fortune, Chaleo’s grandson, was accused of running over a policeman and killing him
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用知情者姿态引出暗面材料,并保持陈述而非渲染
examples.negative_instruction: 不要把指控写成定论;法律状态必须如实限定

examples.psychological_goal: 用成本与售价的对照把溢价飞轮落到数字上,支撑法则
examples.expression_mechanism: 来源限定(estimated)+成本售价对仗,一句装下整个毛利逻辑
examples.example_text: some sources have estimated Red Bull costs about 9 cents per can to make, yet sell them for $1.79 or more.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用成本-售价对照数字给法则提供硬支撑
examples.negative_instruction: 不要把估算写成精确事实;必须保留来源限定词

examples.psychological_goal: 把全部法则压缩成一句可带走的金句,完成情绪与价值双落点
examples.expression_mechanism: not just X but Y 的递进+两个名词短句连击,终极压缩
examples.example_text: the ultimate lesson from Red Bull is to not just sell a product, but sell a feeling. Sell an image.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一句否定递进金句为全片价值封顶
examples.negative_instruction: 不要给空泛鸡汤;金句必须能从前文机制推出

examples.psychological_goal: 用同模式续作预告把结尾导向下一个视频,保持开放环
examples.expression_mechanism: 行动引导+第一人称背书+约会式道别,三连收束
examples.example_text: check out the disturbing history of Coca-Cola by clicking right here. Trust me, it’s a crazy one. I’ll see you there. Cheers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾用"更强的下一个"预告承接流量
examples.negative_instruction: 不要用通用"点赞订阅";预告必须有具体主题钩子
